messages:
Ivy (AE): FYI team  Monolith Bank sent a 110-question RFI + capability matrix. They want technical answers, security questionnaire, POC SOW, and a pricing comparison for Dedicated vs Private. Deadline Friday EOD. I uploaded the source: /shared/monolith/rfi/monolith_rfi_v1.xlsx. Can we split effort?

Omar (SE): I can own the capability matrix and perf estimates. Will flag any questions that need infra/eng. Quick Q: do they expect int8 quantized variants in scope?

Ivy (AE): Yes, they explicitly call out int8 for latency-sensitive inferencing and also ask about function calling and streaming.

Lena (Security): I'll do the security questionnaire. Looks like 32 core items + PCI + BYOK/HSM follow-ups. I'll draft standard responses and highlight legal escalations (export controls + indemnity).

Marco (Sales): I'll handle pricing/POD commercial. Need Omar's QPS/token throughput table to size Dedicated pools. Also include optional on-site audit fee and a Private evaluation add-on.

Omar (SE): Draft capability notes (paste): "Function calling & structured outputs: Supported on Hosted and Dedicated; Private supports this with runtime >= 2.1 and control-plane egress allowlist (ports 443, 8443). Quantization: int8 variants supported on Dedicated/Private with validated profiles; Hosted availability varies by model and will be listed in the catalog. Logging & observability: token-level cost/latency breakdowns available on Console; optional log export to customer buckets."

Lena (Security): Sample security answers: TLS1.2+ for transit, AES-256 at rest, SOC2 controls in place (report available under NDA), RBAC for console, optional cross-tenant log export. BYOK supported via AWS KMS/Azure Key Vault; HSM-backed workflows recommended on Private.

Lena (Security): Flagging for Legal: 1) PCI attestation language (we do not provide Hosted PCI attestation by default) 2) export controls question and 3) model-license indemnity language. Nadia, can you review if I mark these in the sheet?

Nadia (Legal): Yep, ping me on the flagged rows. For model license indemnity we should add a caveat: "Subject to third-party model vendor terms; Redwood will coordinate but cannot extend vendor indemnities without separate agreement."

Marco (Sales): POC SOW sketch: "Week 0: provisioning & VPC peering; Week 1-2: ingestion, perf baselines (embedding vs gen); Week 3: security verification + optional Private smoke test; Week 4: handoff & runbook." Pricing sketch: baseline 4-week Dedicated eval + hourly on-site audit add-on + optional Private evaluation week. I'll add numeric ranges after Omar's sizing.

Omar (SE): Sizing note: sample traffic in their doc shows 70% embeddings (~256 tokens) and 30% gen (avg 1k tokens). For 500 QPS aggregate that maps to ~90k tokens/sec. I'll attach a small table in the matrix.

Ivy (AE): They also asked about failover if Dedicated is exhausted. Suggested blurb?

Omar (SE): "Smart routing with configurable fallback: automatic routing to compatible model variants or alternate region to preserve availability. Customers may pin models to prevent fallback at the route level." Keep it short.

Marco (Sales): Attachments to prepare: capability_matrix_monolith.xlsx (Omar), security_q_monolith.docx (Lena), poc_sow_monolith.pdf (Marco), pricing_ranges_monolith.csv (Marco). Upload folder?

Ivy (AE): Use /shared/monolith/rfi/submission_bundle/. I'll zip after approvals.

drive-bot: Snapshot created: https://drive.internal/s/monolith/rfi/submission_bundle/ :white_check_mark:

Lena (Security): Two quick answers they asked inline: Q: "Who can access audit logs?" A: "For Private, logs remain customer-controlled. For Hosted/Dedicated, logs are tenant-scoped; access is limited to authorized SRE/support with audited access and can be exported to customer storage."

Nadia (Legal): I'll draft an escalation paragraph regarding PCI and model-license caveats to include in the submission.

Ivy (AE): Timeline: Omar by Wed noon for matrix, Lena Wed 3pm for security draft, Marco Wed 5pm for pricing + POC SOW. I'll consolidate Thu morning and do a final pass Thu afternoon. If anything high-risk, tag Nadia immediately. Thanks!
